Name: Shane Georgian Wedding Outfit
Author: Elaho
Description:
[b]UPDATE: V.1.1.3 [or higher] is now compatible with Poltergeister's Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod.[/b]

This mod changes Shane’s wedding outfit to incorporate traditional Georgian (the country, not the State) wedding attire and includes:

-      [i] Kartl-Kakheti chokha/talavari[/i] (high necked coat made of wool) (two different styles, depending on the season)
-      [i] Papakhi[/i] sheepskin hat (depending on the season)
-       [i]Arkhalukhi [/i](shirt-like cloth under the chokha)
-       Silver-string belt
-      [i] Khanjali[/i] scabbard sword
-       Bandolier pockets with [i]Masri [/i](bullet-like accessories)

Georgia is a small country in the Caucasus Mountain region, laying at the intersection of Eastern Europe and West Asia and bordering the
countries of Russia, Turkey, Armenia, and Azerbaijan.

Friendship is extremely important to the Georgian people, so much so that they even consider close friends on par with family (sometimes even above!). However, Georgians can also be quite emotionally reserved and serious in public, so getting to know them can take a long time; but, once you get to know them and earn their trust, they’ll sacrifice almost anything for you.

Thinking of Shane as a character, his relationships with Marnie, Jas, and Jas’ parents, his initial callousness towards your farmer but the willingness to open up emotionally after getting to know you, and his physical features (dark hair, dark eyes, fair/tanned skin), I thought giving him a Georgian background/heritage would suit him really well.

And, after having the love and support of the people around him (including your farmer!), I think Shane would be in a good place where he could proudly showcase and share his cultural heritage with your farmer, on your special day together as partners for life.  

გილოცავთ გათხოვებას!

------------------------------------
*PLEASE NOTE:

[b]UPDATE: V.1.1.3 [or higher] is now compatible with Poltergeister's Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod. No action needed.[/b]

This mod will NOT work with other wedding outfit mods that include Shane. If you want this mod to be compatible with other sprite editing mods, you'll need to either delete Shane's wedding version in those mods or only have this one installed. Having two different mods that change Shane's wedding appearance will not work together and may cause the game to crash.*
